title: Dipaboli: Lyrical, Historical and Patriotic Verses of Assam
author: Sri Dimbeshwar Neog
genre: Historical Poetry, Lyrical Ballads & Assamese Nationalism
description: Celebrated anthology of historic, patriotic, and romantic poems composed by eminent scholar Dimbeshwar Neog, praised by literary pioneers Rajanikanta Bordoloi and Lakshminath Bezbaroa. The verses evoke the heroism of the Ahom kingdom, Patkai mountain crossings, sacred monastic life on the Brahmaputra, and fraternal bonds among indigenous ethnic communities of Assam.
